items.name: theme-brutalist-mono
items.title: Brutalist Mono theme
items.description: Stark black-and-white brutalism with zero radius, thick borders, hard offset shadows, monospace-heavy type and one acid-yellow accent. Best for dev tools, indie launches, manifestos, portfolios and anything that should feel raw, honest and loud.
items.docs: Installed the Brutalist Mono theme. DESIGN.md was written to your project root — keep it there so agents follow it. Text scale utilities: text-display, text-headline-lg, text-headline-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-label-md, text-label-sm, text-mono.

items.name: theme-editorial
items.title: Editorial theme
items.description: Content-first magazine system — warm paper, ink-black type, serif headlines and a single vermilion accent. Best for blogs, publications, docs-as-essays, portfolios and long-form product storytelling.
items.docs: Installed the Editorial theme. DESIGN.md was written to your project root — keep it there so agents follow it. Text scale utilities: text-display, text-headline-lg, text-headline-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-label-md, text-label-sm, text-mono.

items.name: theme-linear-dark
items.title: Linear Dark theme
items.description: Dense, precise, dark-first SaaS chrome in the Linear/Raycast lineage. Best for issue trackers, dev tools, command palettes, dashboards and internal tools where speed and information density matter more than decoration.
items.docs: Dark-only system: add className="dark" to <html>. Installed the Linear Dark theme. DESIGN.md was written to your project root — keep it there so agents follow it. Text scale utilities: text-display, text-headline-lg, text-headline-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-label-md, text-label-sm, text-mono.

items.name: theme-soft-glass
items.title: Soft Glass theme
items.description: Friendly, luminous AI/consumer product system — soft blue-violet gradients, translucent frosted cards and generous rounded shapes. Best for AI assistants, consumer apps, onboarding flows and approachable product marketing.
items.docs: Installed the Soft Glass theme. DESIGN.md was written to your project root — keep it there so agents follow it. Text scale utilities: text-display, text-headline-lg, text-headline-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-label-md, text-label-sm, text-mono.

items.name: kinetic-field
items.title: Kinetic field
items.description: Original cursor-reactive particle sculpture with Orbit, Wave and Sphere forms, free Motion springs, pause/play, an SVG fallback and offscreen cleanup. Theme-aware Canvas 2D; no GPU or Motion+ requirement.

items.name: hero-spotlight
items.title: Hero · Spotlight
items.description: Centered marketing hero with an original static CSS light treatment using the active theme tokens. No animation or proprietary code.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Features · Bento
items.description: Theme-aware bento grid for feature sections. Tiles span 1, 2 or a full row; hover glow uses --primary.

items.name: pricing-simple
items.title: Pricing · Simple
items.description: 2–3 tier pricing with monthly/yearly switch and a featured tier. Pure shadcn primitives + tokens.

items.name: agent-status
items.title: Agent status
items.description: Inline or avatar-size agent activity indicator: libraries.dev thinking-orbs + shimmering verb + detail line.

items.name: beam-card
items.title: Beam card
items.description: Theme-aware card wrapped in libraries.dev's animated border beam — for the one 'live' thing on screen.

items.name: theme-preview
items.title: Theme preview
items.description: Kitchen-sink of the installed theme (swatches, type, buttons, form card). Install after a theme to eyeball it.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Sticky marketing navbar: brand, centred links, ghost + primary actions; collapses into a right-side sheet menu below md.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Hero · Split
items.description: Two-column hero: headline, copy, actions and proof bullets on the left; framed product media on the right (themed mock by default). `reverse` flips sides.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: 'Trusted by' strip. Static wrapping row or infinite marquee with faded edges (pauses on hover, respects reduced motion). Text wordmarks when no SVG is given.

items.name: feature-list
items.title: Features · List
items.description: Icon + title + text feature rows in a 2- or 3-column grid, or heading-left/list-right with columns={1}. Calmer alternative to feature-bento.

items.name: stats-row
items.title: Stats row
items.description: Big-number proof row ('99.99% uptime') with hairline dividers or cards. 2-4 stats.

items.name: testimonials-grid
items.title: Testimonials · Grid
items.description: Masonry grid of customer quotes with avatars; one `featured` quote renders on a --primary fill in larger heading type.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: FAQ section on the shadcn accordion: heading left / questions right (split) or centred single column (stacked).

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: CTA banner
items.description: Closing call-to-action panel. `primary` = full --primary fill with inverted buttons (works on acid-yellow, rust, indigo); `card` = quiet bordered card with a glow.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer · Columns
items.description: Site footer: brand + blurb, 2-5 link columns, bottom bar with copyright, legal links and social icons.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Product app frame on the shadcn sidebar: brand header, grouped nav with badges, user dropdown, icon-collapse (Cmd/Ctrl+B) and mobile sheet; header bar with breadcrumbs + action slot; content slot.

items.name: stat-cards
items.title: Stat cards
items.description: Dashboard KPI tiles: label, big value, delta chip (invertible for churn/latency) and an SVG sparkline in --chart-1.

items.name: data-table-card
items.title: Data table card
items.description: shadcn table in a card with toolbar: search, faceted filter, actions slot, sortable columns, row selection and pagination. Badge columns are server-safe; `cell` renderers need a client page.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Zero-data / first-run placeholder: layered icon, title, one primary next step, optional secondary + help link. Dashed drop-zone or plain.

items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings form
items.description: Account settings page (profile, preferences, notifications, danger zone) plus the SettingsSection / SettingsRow primitives to compose your own.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: AI conversation view: user bubbles, assistant turns with markdown-ish text + code blocks, tool-call chips, copy/vote/regenerate actions, @oc/agent-status while pending. Auto-sticks to bottom.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: Chat input: auto-growing textarea, file attachment chips, model picker, web-search toggle, send/stop; Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline; optional suggestion chips.

items.name: feature-levels
items.title: Features · Levels (scroll-spy)
items.description: Multi-level feature walkthrough: two-tone headline, sticky numbered scroll-spy nav, large photo panels with floating glass product-UI cards (LevelCard), title + CTA per level. Free, theme-aware take on Aceternity's Pro multi-level-features block.

items.name: design-lab
items.title: Design lab (temporary option board)
items.description: Temporary page an agent installs in a consumer project to render candidate variants of the user's own component side by side, with their theme and content: <DesignLab title> + <LabOption id label notes chosen>. Lands at app/design-lab/page.tsx + components/design-lab.tsx; the user says which option they want, the agent applies it and removes both files.

items.name: template-landing
items.title: Template · SaaS landing page
items.description: Full marketing page at app/page.tsx: navbar, split hero, marquee logo cloud, feature bento, stats, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, CTA banner and footer — all @oc blocks, all theme tokens. Install a theme first, then replace the copy.

items.name: template-saas-dashboard
items.title: Template · SaaS dashboard
items.description: Dashboard at app/dashboard/page.tsx: @oc/app-shell sidebar + breadcrumbs, KPI stat cards with sparklines, revenue area chart (shadcn chart), recent-activity card and a searchable, filterable customers table.

items.name: template-ai-chat
items.title: Template · AI chat
items.description: Assistant UI at app/chat/page.tsx: conversation sidebar (@oc/app-shell), @oc/chat-thread with tool-call chips, @oc/agent-status while the model works, and @oc/prompt-composer pinned to the bottom. Fake responder included — swap in your streaming call.

items.name: motion-presets
items.title: Motion presets
items.description: design-infra's motion languages (still / quiet / lively / cinematic) as motion/react transitions, springs and variants (fadeUp, scaleIn, stagger, press, lift). Set PROJECT_MOTION to your DESIGN.md `motion:` so hand-written animations match the system.
